clue.text: Attendant in a mess (that's official, of course)

definitions.meaning: one who serves food and drink in a military or naval dining hall
an official who supervises a race meeting at a racecourse

explanation.walkthrough: 'Course' is a racecourse here, where stewards police the running of races.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: a mess servant and a racing official both bear this title.

clue.text: Island where spring starts frostily

indicators.note: the word spring starts with its opening letter, which is all that is taken

parts.note: frostily, of a cold manner, means icily

explanation.surface: A question about an island where the spring season begins with frost.
explanation.definitionFit: A Mediterranean island off the toe of Italy, the largest in that sea.

clue.text: Show how Venice developed

indicators.note: developed suggests the letters of Venice have been worked into a new form

explanation.surface: Asking to be shown how the city of Venice grew historically.
explanation.definitionFit: To evince a feeling is to display or reveal it, a synonym of show.

clue.text: Sam's abroad, working as a diplomat

indicators.note: working signals that the letters of Sam's abroad are put to work in a new order

explanation.surface: Sam is posted overseas, serving in the diplomatic corps.
explanation.definitionFit: An ambassador is the senior diplomat representing a country abroad.

clue.text: Loincloth can make a number very warm, I conclude

indicators.note: I conclude says the letter I comes at the end of the build

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for five hundred
very warm means hot

explanation.surface: Someone notes that a loincloth can make you rather hot, they conclude.
explanation.definitionFit: The dhoti is the traditional Indian garment wrapped around the waist and legs.

clue.text: Idly follows one's fancy as a scribbler

definitions.text: Idly follows one's fancy as a scribbler

parts.words: Idly follows one's fancy as a scribbler
parts.note: describes someone absent-mindedly making random sketches with a pen

explanation.surface: A writer drifting wherever whim leads.
explanation.definitionFit: Idle aimless drawing on paper is exactly what a scribbler does when the mind wanders.

clue.text: Fire — or let off?

definitions.meaning: to fire a gun, or to dismiss someone from a job
to release a prisoner or free someone from duty

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers firing a weapon or sacking an employee, and also releasing or acquitting someone.

clue.text: Square cuts, surprisingly, may be seen there

definitions.text: Square cuts, surprisingly, may be seen there

parts.words: Square cuts, surprisingly, may be seen there
parts.note: a square cut is a cricket stroke, and it is surprising to see square things at a rounded shape

explanation.surface: Something square appearing in a place that is anything but square.
explanation.walkthrough: THE OVAL is a London Test cricket ground; a square cut is a batting stroke played there.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous cricket ground is named for its rounded, egg-like playing field.

clue.text: Two requirements of a ship's captain from a humble background?

definitions.text: Two requirements of a ship's captain from a humble background?

parts.words: Two requirements of a ship's captain from a humble background?
parts.note: a captain keeps a written voyage record and has a private room aboard; a modest wooden dwelling suggests humble origins

explanation.surface: Listing what a ship's master needs, while hinting at a lowly upbringing.
explanation.walkthrough: The ship's record book and the captain's quarters join to make the timber hut of 'log cabin to White House' fame.
explanation.definitionFit: A simple house of tree trunks is the classic emblem of a humble start in life.

clue.text: Perverted anti-Mass in devil worship

indicators.note: perverted means twisted out of shape, so the letters of anti-Mass are twisted

explanation.surface: A twisted rite opposed to the Mass, practised by devil worshippers.
explanation.definitionFit: The worship of Satan is the devil cult the definition describes.

clue.text: Scramble up and get caught by branch

indicators.note: by puts the first piece next to the branch piece

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
a branch of a tree is a limb

explanation.surface: Clambering up a tree and getting snagged on a branch.
explanation.definitionFit: To scramble up a slope or tree is to ascend it, a synonym.

clue.text: Offensive lout hangs around

indicators.note: around suggests the letters of lout hangs are moved about

explanation.surface: An offensive yob loitering about the place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Offensive' looks like an adjective about the lout but is a noun here, an attack.
explanation.definitionFit: An onslaught is a fierce military attack, which is an offensive as a noun.

clue.text: Key workers?

parts.note: key workers are essential staff, but read literally these are people who work on keys

explanation.surface: A reference to essential staff in vital public jobs.
explanation.definitionFit: Tradespeople who cut keys and fit locks literally work with keys all day.

clue.text: Bird takes direction at first light

parts.note: a daw, or jackdaw, is a bird of the crow family
N is north, a compass direction

explanation.surface: A bird sets its course as the sun rises.
explanation.definitionFit: First light is the moment of daybreak, when the sun appears.

clue.text: Not the true origin of race?

definitions.text: Not the true origin of race?

parts.words: Not the true origin of race?
parts.note: suggests a debate on ethnic origins, but means a race start that has to be rerun

explanation.surface: Seems to question a theory about where a people came from.
explanation.definitionFit: When a runner jumps the gun the race has to be restarted, so that beginning was not the real one.

clue.text: Advisers are represented on opposing sides

indicators.note: represented means presented anew, so the letters of advisers are appear in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Consultants turn up on both sides of a dispute.
explanation.definitionFit: Opponents in a contest or conflict are the sides set against each other.

clue.text: Noted bowman

parts.note: seems to mean a famous archer, but describes a musician who plays notes with a bow

explanation.surface: A celebrated archer such as Robin Hood.
explanation.definitionFit: A fiddle player draws a bow across strings to produce musical notes.

clue.text: Jests appear stale as they grow old

parts.note: stale food has gone bad
growing old is advancing in age, giving in age

explanation.surface: Old jokes seem to go stale with time.
explanation.definitionFit: Badinage is playful teasing banter, a stream of light jokes.

clue.text: Row not unexpected in Belfast's parliament

parts.note: a row, a noisy quarrel, is a storm

indicators.note: unexpected indicates the letters of not turn up in a surprising order

explanation.surface: A political row in Northern Ireland's assembly is hardly a surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: The Northern Ireland Assembly sits at Stormont, an estate on the edge of Belfast.

clue.text: No more stars twinkling for those who watch at night

indicators.note: twinkling stars flicker and shift, so the letters of no more stars are shifted

explanation.surface: Stargazers lament that no more stars shine for them.
explanation.definitionFit: Scientists studying the heavens do their observing in the dark hours.

clue.text: Sound observation, using a quote

indicators.note: sound tells us to take the noise a word makes, not its spelling

parts.note: an observation of something, a glimpse, is a sighting

explanation.surface: A sensible remark supported by a quotation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like an adjective meaning sensible but is the indicator.
explanation.definitionFit: Citing a source means quoting it as evidence or authority.

clue.text: River veers roughly north

indicators.note: roughly signals that the letters of veers are arranged only approximately

explanation.surface: A river swerves on its course towards the north.
explanation.definitionFit: Britain's longest waterway, flowing from Wales to the Bristol Channel.

clue.text: Having free rein with regard to the matter

indicators.note: free here tells us the letters of rein are set loose to rearrange

explanation.surface: Being given full liberty over some business.
explanation.definitionFit: The Latin legal phrase used in memos means concerning or on the subject of.

clue.text: Girl's letter giving the brush off?

parts.note: Di, short for Diana, is a girl's name; with the possessive it gives DIS
a missive is a letter

explanation.surface: A girl's letter that rejects her suitor.
explanation.definitionFit: Being curt and contemptuous, waving someone away, is the attitude described.

clue.text: Fruit gives chap vitality

parts.note: a chap is a man
go means energy or vitality

explanation.surface: Eating fruit gives a fellow energy.
explanation.definitionFit: A tropical stone fruit with sweet orange flesh.

clue.text: Silver taken in church — just a pound!

indicators.note: taken in says one piece is received inside the other

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: Someone grumbles that the church collection yielded only a pound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pound' is not money but an enclosure for animals.
explanation.definitionFit: A pound is an enclosure for animals; a cage is just such a pen, hence the exclamation.

clue.text: A girl getting into giddy hero worship?

parts.note: Dora is a girl's name

indicators.note: giddy means dizzy and whirling, so the letters of into spin round

explanation.surface: A young woman being swept up in dizzy idolisation of a hero.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting' joins: A DORA is followed by TION, the letters of 'into' scrambled.
explanation.definitionFit: Hero worship is intense admiring devotion, which the question mark marks as an example.

clue.text: A newly married woman has no right to stay

indicators.note: has no means the letter for right is left out

parts.note: a newly married woman is a bride

explanation.surface: A newlywed has no entitlement to remain.
explanation.definitionFit: To abide is to remain or dwell, an old synonym of stay.

clue.text: Press hard for change in net rate

indicators.note: change in tells us the letters of net rate are altered in order

explanation.surface: Lobbying hard for a different net interest rate.
explanation.definitionFit: To beg or implore someone earnestly is to press them hard.

clue.text: Figure of eight

parts.note: seems to be the looped shape, but means a geometric figure with eight sides

explanation.surface: The looping skating or knot shape.
explanation.definitionFit: A polygon with eight sides and eight angles is a figure made of eight.
